text: Filings test started. Question: do SEC filings flag small caps before they move? XHG, AIBZ, FUFU, YMAT, MASK are foreign issuers and file no Form 4s. Open-market insider buys came about 4 weeks before CTSO (+18.7%) and ANNX (+13.2%). Big new stakes came before TCRT (Fairmount 13D 19.99%) and XLAB (ARC 13G 14.7%). WORX had a resale S-3 for 13.1M shares vs 0.55M float filed Oct 16, the day it spiked and failed, and still ran +172% from the open on Oct 19. Tracking every new filing in the Filings tab: price on filing day, then +5/+10/+30 day closes and best high within 30 days.
